title: Reform UK considers pact with Restore Britain to overcome stalling performance in polls
summary_full: Thursday’s byelection in Castle Bromwich will be latest test for Nigel Farage’s party as rival eats into supportVoters go to the polls in the village of Castle Bromwich in the West Midlands on Thursday in a little-noticed election that is the latest test for Reform at a time when it is particularly vulnerable.Yet, while it is the Conservatives who are edging ahead in recent polls, the decisive difference could well be the performance of Restore Britain – the hard-right party set up by Rupert Lowe after the MP fell out with Nigel Farage.
